author: Fan Chen
description:
When the presidents of the United States and China meet in Washington, the world will be watching to see whether their two countries can make good on their agreement to work towards “constructive strategic stability”. In the second part of a series, Fan Chen looks at Beijing’s stronger position going into the high-stakes visit.
Beijing is poised to begin this week’s summit with Washington from a position of strength, bolstered by a flurry of recent diplomatic outreach.
Chinese confidence could...
title: Analysts tip a stronger hand for China ahead of Xi-Trump summit in Washington

author: Zhengxu Wang
description:
On September 12, Chinese President Xi Jinping met Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi on the sidelines of the Brics summit in New Delhi. In their talks, Xi said China approached the relationship “from a strategic and long-term perspective”.
He called for an objective and rational “strategic” perception. That means the two sides should treat each other as partners rather than rivals, and as opportunities rather than threats.
In Chinese official and diplomatic language, the term “strategic” is...
title: What China really means when it says it’s being ‘strategic’

author: Shi Huang
description:
An airport is an unlikely place to search for national origins but researchers say they have uncovered the tomb of the woman behind the man who unified China – next to a major city runway.
The researchers said the tomb was believed to belong to Empress Dowager Huayang, the adoptive grandmother of Qin Shi Huang, who unified the warring states more than 2,200 years ago.
“I believe the most likely identity of the tomb owner is Empress Dowager Huayang,” Zhao Hanqing, from the Shaanxi Provincial...
title: Is China’s fabled Empress Dowager Huayang buried near an airport? A study says yes

author: Jevans Nyabiage
description:
For more than a decade, China has deployed warships to the Gulf of Aden and the waters off Somalia.
For much of that time, piracy in the region has been in sharp decline. Now, however, with attacks at their highest reported level since 2013 and other naval forces engaged in crises elsewhere, Beijing’s long-running escort mission is being tested.
The renewed attacks and hijacking for ransom come as the US Navy focuses on operations connected to the war on Iran, and India sends ships towards the...
title: Somali piracy rise tests China’s long-running Gulf of Aden mission

author: Albee Zhang
description:
The US deployment of space weapons has shattered a long-held taboo and risks igniting a fresh arms race, with the world at a “breaking point in history”, speakers at a major security conference in Beijing have warned.
Experts at the Xiangshan Forum this week also called for US-China dialogue on space security, just days before Chinese President Xi Jinping makes his first state visit to the US in more than a decade.
US Air Force Secretary Troy Meink – the civilian head of the department that...
title: US space weapons move has ‘broken taboo’, could spark new arms race, Beijing forum told

author: Dannie Peng
description:
Fragments of a long-disappeared ancient giant land mass have been discovered buried deep beneath parts of the modern continents that once formed it, according to an international team led by Chinese scientists.
Published this month in the peer-reviewed journal Science Advances, the discovery reveals that Gondwana – a land mass that dominated Earth some 500 million years ago – was much larger than previously believed.
Crucially, the findings show how geological activity related to Gondwana...
title: China-led study reveals ‘Greater Gondwana’ was 80% of Earth’s crust 500m years ago

author: Reuters
description:
For years, the race to build ever more powerful artificial intelligence followed a well-worn Silicon ⁠Valley principle: move fast and break things.
But in a series of cascading events over a 10-day stretch, the largest ⁠AI labs found themselves reeling as their own creations threatened to break humanity itself.
An Anthropic researcher quit the firm, warning that the pace of AI development poses an existential threat, possibly within a decade.
Another researcher at the firm said the odds of human...
title: AI: 10 days that changed the course of artificial intelligence

author: Carol Yang
description:
US President Donald Trump’s claim of “permanent” security control over Greenland just days ahead of a state visit by his Chinese counterpart is an effort to boost US leverage, according to analysts.
However, they warned of a potential negative impact on the high-stakes talks, citing broader risks to major-power trust and peaceful Arctic development.
In a social media post on Friday, Trump said: “I am pleased to announce that the United States of America has entered into an Agreement with The...
title: Trump’s Greenland deal aims to boost leverage at Xi summit, midterms: analysts

author: Jevans Nyabiage
description:
Six Chinese J-16 fighter jets arrived in Egypt last month for a joint exercise in what was the aircraft’s first known deployment in Africa.
In Egyptian airspace, Chinese pilots had the rare chance to train against the Rafale, an advanced French-built fighter.
The 6,000km (3,700-mile) deployment was completed in about nine hours with aerial refuelling, and tested China’s ability to move and support a combat-capable air package far from home.
Analysts say the exercise reflects a decades-long...
title: Is Africa becoming a ‘testing ground’ for Chinese power projection?

author: Lawrence Chung
description:
In a rare development, Taiwanese Labour Minister Hung Sun-han is expected to travel to Nanjing on Sunday, becoming the first cabinet-level official under William Lai Ching-te’s administration to visit mainland China.
Hung will attend an Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) ministerial meeting on Monday to discuss employment, vocational training, social security and the impact of artificial intelligence on jobs.
Hung will be the most senior Taiwanese official to visit the mainland for Apec...
title: How will Beijing receive most senior Taiwan official to attend Apec events this year?

author: Khushboo Razdan
description:
Donald Trump and Melania Trump will host Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan together across two days in Washington next week: a White House welcome, a state dinner at which both presidents speak, a private tea, and a tour of the United States’ founding documents.
Senior US officials set out the programme late Friday and said the pageantry will sit beside talks on artificial intelligence, a trade truce that expires in November, rare earths, fentanyl and detained foreigners.
The briefing confirmed much of...
title: Trump, Melania to host Xi and Peng for White House ‘double date’: full schedule

author: Nayan Seth,Khushboo Razdan,William Zheng,Dewey Sim
description:
The United States is considering postponing the announcement of major arms sales to Taiwan until after November’s Apec summit in Shenzhen, multiple sources told the South China Morning Post. The potential delay comes as Chinese President Xi Jinping prepares to travel to Washington next week for a state visit.
The sources said there was a strong possibility US President Donald Trump could extend the delay through to the end of the year, pointing to a planned bilateral meeting between the two...
title: US weighs delaying Taiwan arms sales until after Apec and G20 summits
